_comment: Curated breadth grid for the home page. The featured deck is identified by featured: true (positional order is not load-bearing — the implementer should select by flag, not by index). Featured deck plays inline on click; remaining decks link through to detail pages. See HOMEPAGE-IMPLEMENTATION-PROMPT.md §5.2 and §6.3. Operator-managed via git; no DB query at home-page render. File belongs at frontend/config/homepage-featured-decks.json. Thumbnail and deck URLs follow the canonical nginx serving pattern from CLAUDE.md §15.7: https://lessoncraftstudio.com/<locale>/decks/<slug>/. The topic field supports the no-two-thumbnails-on-same-topic invariant from HOMEPAGE-SAVE-STATE.md Section 2.

_known_state_notes: Deck titles are operator-authored at app-side and stored verbatim per row in the DB. Locale heterogeneity is observable across Tier 1 (DE rows mix DE-native titles like 'Additionsspaß' / 'Wörter suchen' with English-language titles) and now extends to Tier 2 (es + nl rows currently carry English-language titles like 'Grid Match' / 'Picture Sort' / 'Missing Pieces' / 'Chart Count' per operator authoring at first-publish time). Titles above mirror DB state verbatim; do NOT auto-translate or normalize. Per CLAUDE.md §17.5 Tier 1 EN+DE discipline + Tier 2 follow-on, operator may revise specific titles in a future content-authoring pass.
